category_title: Students with EBD experiencing behavioral outbursts and academic difficulties in science
minimal_context: Sam is in science class and is asked to read a passage from the textbook aloud to study new vocabulary words.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Sam, please read the next paragraph from the science textbook aloud so we can go over the new vocabulary words.

STUDENT: I like science, but I don't want to read the textbook. I'm not reading it out loud.

TUTOR: Just do your best and read the first sentence for us.

STUDENT: (Looks around the room defensively) No! The other students are just going to make fun of me. I know they are!

TUTOR: No one is going to make fun of you. Go ahead and start reading.

STUDENT: (Slams the textbook shut and yells at a nearby peer) What are you looking at?! I'm not reading this stupid book! Leave me alone!

options.A: Introduce mnemonic strategies (keyword, pegword, and letter mnemonics) for the new vocabulary words.
options.B: Agree with the student that they are having a rough time with the reading task.
options.C: Prompt the student to call on a neighbor, ask a friend, or poll the class.
options.D: Walk around the room and stand directly behind the student during the reading activity.
